name: PolyCup
author: Kiki
description: Live Cups for 2–8 racers with customizable presets, track drafting, live rankings and buffered spectator POV.
changelog: Fixed split-update stutters in longer Cups, missing last-checkpoint splits (including single-checkpoint tracks such as Desert 3), and chat scrolling when switching lobby tabs. Improved finish delivery under high latency and packet backlogs. Removed Cup autosaves, restoration, and player-management arrows from final results.
